data.name: Dheeravi
data.gender_notes: Dheeravi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dheeravi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dheerah’, meaning fearless or brave. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess the qualities of courage and strength. In Hindu mythology, Dheeravi is the name of a brave and beautiful demoness who was known for her strength and determination. The name Dheeravi carries the meaning “Fearless, Courageous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dheeravi usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength and courage, inspiring fearlessness in the face of adversity.
